hints: There's a corner of this room that looks picked over by someone who gave up too early.
A loose panel, a sagging shelf. Something could be back there.
The dust is disturbed in one place. Only one.

eventText.reward.announce: SPONSOR NOTICE: a crate is being dropped in the {room} in a few hours. It will not wait for you.
eventText.reward.start: The sponsor crate has landed in the {room}. It is on a timer, like everything.
eventText.reward.end: The sponsor crate in the {room} has been reclaimed. Nobody will tell you who by.
eventText.closing.announce: FLOOR MAINTENANCE: the section around the {room} closes soon. Anyone still inside will be treated as having made a choice.
eventText.closing.start: The section around the {room} has sealed. You can't get in. It is going to be fine.
eventText.closing.pushed: The walls come down around you. You are thrown clear, and it costs you {damage} HP.
eventText.surge.announce: AUDIENCE ENGAGEMENT: viewership is soft. Additional contestants-adjacent staff will be released on the final day.
eventText.surge.start: The surge is released. Every room you cleared is a little less clear.
eventText.hint.announce: The System AI helpfully mentions that a way down is somewhere near the {room}.
eventText.heal.announce: A complimentary snack cart passed through the floor. It healed you {pct}% on its way by.
eventText.debuff.announce: An hour of loud, unskippable announcements. You lose {minutes} minutes and any will to live.
